workingResolutionPolicy: use the nearest supported 16:9 generation size; upscale only after visual approval

referenceRoles.ensembleDensitySeed: SEED-D — only for crowd/event density; never for VA03 lineup style
referenceRoles.assetBoardLayoutSeed: SEED-E — fallback layout logic only; accepted Human Board overrides it for VA03 lineup appearance
referenceRoles.sceneSpecificReferences: use only approved Scene Visual Packet references

seedPolicy: seed control is not exposed by current runtime; no seed-level reproducibility claim
referenceSlotPolicy: For every non-Human VA03 preflight, load the matching VA01 species exemplar as the anatomy image authority, plus locked VA01/VA02 rendering authorities and the accepted Human Board only for board/layout/rendering behavior. Never use the Human Board as the anatomical base canvas.
upscalePolicy: no style-changing upscale; upscale only after scene/board approval
faceDetailCorrectionPolicy: correct inside the same locked visual grammar; do not use a separate face style

speciesBoardPreflight.method: generate/transform one isolated target-species sample from official species facts + the matching VA01 species exemplar; apply accepted Human Board only as board/layout/rendering grammar
speciesBoardPreflight.anatomyAuthority: official 5E/SRD facts + matching VA01 species exemplar
speciesBoardPreflight.renderingAuthority: VA01 + current VA02 Face Grammar + accepted Human Board board/rendering grammar
speciesBoardPreflight.dwarfTarget: D02 / DB02 STANDARD DENSE / adult feminine Dwarf

styleDriftAbortConditions: gray studio concept-sheet background replacing the accepted white board
high-detail armor/material concept art replacing simple calibration clothing
fine portrait linework replacing bold hand-drawn contours
new infographic panels/turnarounds/headshot grids not present in the accepted Human Board
nonHumanAnatomySourceRule: Never derive non-Human anatomy from the accepted Human Board. The Human Board controls board/layout/rendering behavior only.

speciesAnatomyReferencePolicy.rule: Each non-Human species requires its own matching VA01 exemplar loaded as an actual image reference before preflight.
